summary: InflaRx N.V., a Dutch-incorporated, Germany-based clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, furnished a Form 6-K with its unaudited condensed consolidated financial statements and MD&A for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026. The exhibits are incorporated by reference into its Form S-8 and Form F-3 registration statements. Financials show nine-month revenue of €23,830, R&D of roughly €11.9 million, and a net loss of €18.7 million with cash disclosed in the notes. This is a routine periodic-reporting-equivalent filing, not a special situation; watch liquidity runway and any subsequent financing.
